name: Ant They Were Roommates
source:
Four queen of ants have been kidnapped into a single house. Before the food runs out, they'll have to either work together and build their colony, or eliminate all the others.

As the only Polyneoptera here, white ant queen "Shiro" has no ability to fight against the other real ants. Without even wanting to become a queen, the only choice she was given...is to convince them into helping her escape, by using the magic of LOVE.

[From [url=https://daruku-darc.itch.io/ant]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
四只蚁后被绑架到一所房子里。在食物耗尽之前，他们必须要么共同努力建立自己的殖民地，要么消灭所有其他人。

作为这里唯一的多新翅目，白蚁后“四郎”没有能力与其他真正的蚂蚁对抗。她甚至不想成为女王，唯一的选择就是……说服他们通过爱的魔力帮助她逃脱。

[来自[url=https://daruku-darc.itch.io/ant]itch.io[/url]]
